name: [VERITY!] Hood Modded
desc:
Current Platform Support: Console, Tablets, Phones and Computers!

⚔️ Build your own crew and be the most infamous from all of them!

Commands:
/e stats - Shows stats
!rejoin - Rejoin Server

[Computer Controls]
            
[G - Carry]
[LCTRL - Crouch]
[LCTRL - Ragdoll Thrown]

🎮Account has to be at least 1 day old to play.
💾Gun saves - can be lost by death or logging when KO.

💎 Special thanks to Benoxa and iumu.
🔨 Created by Nex5us.
⭐ Inspired by Da Hood.
